narration:0:1610412001:0.text: The challenge is over, and you are teleported back to the Interrealm.
narration:0:1610412001:0.source_cn: 挑战结束，你被传送回了界域之间
narration:0:1610412001:0.male: The challenge is over, and you are teleported back to the Interrealm.
narration:0:1610412001:0.female: The challenge is over, and you are teleported back to the Interrealm.

narration:1:1610412002:0.text: Meanwhile, in the viewing box of the selection judges...
narration:1:1610412002:0.source_cn: 与此同时，在选拔赛评审团的观战区中——
narration:1:1610412002:0.male: Meanwhile, in the viewing box of the selection judges...
narration:1:1610412002:0.female: Meanwhile, in the viewing box of the selection judges...

say:3:1610412003:1.text: Interesting... This student, who defeated the monster first, seems to have much stronger control and understanding of magic than the others.
say:3:1610412003:1.source_cn: 嗯……有意思，这位第一个击败怪物的学生，对魔法的掌控和...
say:3:1610412003:1.male: Interesting... This student, who defeated the monster first, seems to have much stronger control and understanding of magic than the others.
say:3:1610412003:1.female: Interesting... This student, who defeated the monster first, seems to have much stronger control and understanding of magic than the others.

say:4:1610412004:1.text: No need for such wide eyes, Cyran. Some students are just born with a little extra sparkle in their wand, don't you know?
say:4:1610412004:1.source_cn: 喔哈哈，这不是什么值得大惊小怪的事情，总有些人是天赋异...

say:5:1610412005:1.text: Ah, I still recall the exceptional spark you showed in your youth! Seeing the mage you've become... it truly warms this old heart. I'm so very proud of you.
say:5:1610412005:1.source_cn: 我记得你当年在学校的时候也是天赋卓越的学生，这从你现在...

say:6:1610412006:1.text: Your acknowledgment is... appreciated, Headmaster. One can only hope your physical vigor has managed to keep pace with your nostalgic sentiments.
say:6:1610412006:1.source_cn: 感谢你的肯定，校长先生，不知道你的身体是否也像过去一样...

say:7:1610412007:1.text: Goodness me, this old vessel may have a few more creaks than it did two decades past, but everything still sails! You, on the other hand, look like a wandering ghost. A bit of sun would do you wonders!
say:7:1610412007:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，我的身体虽然不如二十多年前那么强壮，偶尔会有些...

say:8:1610412008:1.text: Looks like the royal court of Savannah has done what final exams never could. They've sucked the life right out of our brightest graduate.
say:8:1610412008:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈，赛凡纳王室终于把莱希拉姆最优秀的毕业生也折磨...

say:9:1610412009:1.text: Oh, Headmaster, you and your jests. But come now, let's not pretend. We both know who the Lyceum's brightest graduate is.
say:9:1610412009:1.source_cn: 呵，校长先生，你还是一如既往的风趣。你我都知道，“最优...

say:10:1610412010:1.text: As for this year's class... I heard even before I arrived that there are a few exceptional students: Cassadee and Gervan.
say:10:1610412010:1.source_cn: 至于这一届……我在来之前就听闻这一届有几位非常出色的学...
say:10:1610412010:1.male: As for this year's class... I heard even before I arrived that there are a few exceptional students: Cassadee and Gervan.
say:10:1610412010:1.female: As for this year's class... I heard even before I arrived that there are a few exceptional students: Cassadee and Gervan.

say:11:1610412011:1.text: But now it seems that none of them can compare to...
say:11:1610412011:1.source_cn: 但现在看来，他们似乎都比不上这位……
say:11:1610412011:1.male: But now it seems that none of them can compare to...
say:11:1610412011:1.female: But now it seems that none of them can compare to...

say:13:1610412013:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... It seems I've heard a similar name from afar. Strange, isn't it? For someone with his raw talent to be so overlooked, while everyone chatters on about Cassadee and Gervan.
say:13:1610412013:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... It seems I've heard a similar name from afar. Strange, isn't it? For someone with his raw talent to be so overlooked, while everyone chatters on about Cassadee and Gervan.
say:13:1610412013:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... It seems I've heard a similar name from afar. Strange, isn't it? For someone with her raw talent to be so overlooked, while everyone chatters on about Cassadee and Gervan.

say:14:1610412014:1.text: For some, being widely renowned isn't necessarily better than being obscure.
say:14:1610412014:1.source_cn: 呵、呵、呵！对学生来说，声名显赫不见得比默默无闻更好。

say:15:1610412015:1.text: He must also be a student who was admitted through special admissions.
say:15:1610412015:1.male: He must also be a student who was admitted through special admissions.
say:15:1610412015:1.female: She must also be a student who was admitted through special admissions.

say:17:1610412016:1.text: And yet, he lacks both title and renown. A commoner with no name to speak of... simply "<style="stress"><player_name></style>". How... curiously quaint.
say:17:1610412016:1.male: And yet, he lacks both title and renown. A commoner with no name to speak of... simply "<style="stress"><player_name></style>". How... curiously quaint.
say:17:1610412016:1.female: And yet, she lacks both title and renown. A commoner with no name to speak of... simply "<style="stress"><player_name></style>". How... curiously quaint.

say:18:1610412017:1.text: Hahaha... For a court mage to bestow such attention upon an ordinary student, it seems this year's class is truly exceptionally gifted.
say:18:1610412017:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，宫廷魔法师竟然会对一位普通学生投以这么高的关注...
say:18:1610412017:1.male: Hahaha... For a court mage to bestow such attention upon an ordinary student, it seems this year's class is truly exceptionally gifted.
say:18:1610412017:1.female: Hahaha... For a court mage to bestow such attention upon an ordinary student, it seems this year's class is truly exceptionally gifted.

say:19:1610412018:1.text: Look! Those excellent candidates have already passed the first test!
say:19:1610412018:1.source_cn: 瞧——那些优秀的候选者已经纷纷通过第一关了。
